notes.title: Optimization patch
notes.notes: Once you enter the initial menu, the game's quality mode is configured through a hardware test, the settings tab was also changed to a tab that allows you to choose between low, medium, high and epic, to make it clearer for the user, the loading of level streaming was also modified, it should now occur in a smoother way, smooth framerate was also implemented for a more fluid experience.

notes.title: Optimization patch
notes.notes:
Several optimizations have been made to the game, such as level streaming, reduced draw calls, and reduced memory usage. This should result in improved game launch and loading.

If anyone has had a negative experience due to the optimization, I apologize and hope the game experience is more satisfying now.
